title: The union of Castile and Portugal breaks. From 1 May 1389 Castile has its own king, Fernando, while Jerónimo keeps Portugal. The two crowns remain allies, but for the first time since 1367 they are truly split

data.alliance: Castile and Portugal still allied (save of 2 January 1394)

title: A third office of the bureaucracy, as the empire turns slowly toward trade: the Ḥisba, under the muḥtasib, who polices the markets and the public morals of the Islamic city, checks weights and measures, puts down fraud and enforces honest dealing. While the crown pays for it, al-Andalus sells better and its economy moves toward capital

data.precedent: a well-run inspectorate keeps commerce honest and gives the state the authority of the devout; a corrupt one is felt only as meddling, and merchants withdraw into networks beyond its reach (the game's text)
